did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A shopper put Napa in the cart, opened checkout, set Needed by (time) to 18:30 and added a photo (a picture of the strip), then sent the order. The buyer's order page and the owner's order screen were opened.

checks.text: Checkout has Needed by (time), a voice note and a Photo box; the order was accepted with the time and photo
The buyer's order page shows "Needed by 18:30 - Photo sent"
The owner's order screen shows "Needed by 18:30" at the top and the photo itself, so staff see both before packing

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. The photo was made on the page (a plain picture with words) instead of picked from a phone, and the voice note was not recorded.

shots.caption: Owner: the needed-by time and the photo on the order
Buyer: the order that was sent
